records.title: Simple roast chicken
records.instructions:
1. Pat the chicken dry and rub it with oil and salt.
2. Insert an instant-read thermometer into the thickest part of the thigh and cook to 165 °F (74 °C).
3. Rest the bird for 10 minutes before carving.

records.title: Weeknight burgers
records.instructions:
1. Form the beef into patties.
2. Cook to 160 °F, checked with a thermometer.

records.title: Juicy pork chops
records.instructions: 1. Cook to 145 °F with a food thermometer, then rest at least 3 minutes.

records.text: Cool leftovers in shallow containers and refrigerate within two hours.
